documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Omax Autos submitted its Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26 to the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. and BSE Limited pursuant to Regulation 34 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company stated that the Integrated Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26 is made available on its website at www.omaxauto.com. The submission letter was signed by Company Secretary & Compliance Officer Kannu Sharma on July 30, 2026. Omax Autos has proposed the re-appointment of its top management, including the Vice Chairman and Managing Director, for terms starting in 2025 and 2026.

margins_costs.claim: The company ratified the remuneration of Rs. 1,20,000 for its Cost Auditors for the 2025-26 financial year.
margins_costs.quote: the remuneration of Rs. 1,20,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Twenty Thousand Only) plus applicable taxes and out of pockets expenses as recommended by the audit committee and approved by the board of directors to be paid to M/s JSN & Co., Cost auditors of the Company for the financial year 2025-26 be and is hereby ratified and confirmed.

margins_costs.claim: The company approved a remuneration limit of Rs. 1,10,00,000 per annum for the Managing Director for a three-year period starting July 2026.
margins_costs.quote: the remuneration for a period of 3 (three) years from 19th July, 2026 to 18th July, 2029 as set out in the Contract of Service, for an amount not exceeding Rs. 1,10,00,000/- (Rupees One Crores Ten Lakhs Only) per annum be and is hereby approved;

margins_costs.claim: The company efficiently worked on reduction of its overall overheads.
margins_costs.quote: The Company has efficiently worked on reduction of its overall overheads.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 2.50 per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a Dividend of 2.50/- (Rupees Two and Fifty Paise only.) per Equity Share fully paid up of Rs. 10/- each for the financial year ended March 31, 2025, subject to the approval of the Shareholders at the AGM.

capital_allocation.claim: Unclaimed dividends are transferred to the Investor Education and Protection Fund after a consecutive period of seven years.
capital_allocation.quote: Members are requested to note that, dividends if not encashed for a consecutive period of 7 years from the date of transfer to Unpaid Dividend Account of the Company, are liable to be transferred to the Investor Education and Protection Fund (“IEPF”).

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of Re. 1 per fully paid-up equity share of Rs. 10 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a Final Dividend of 1/- (Rupee One only) per Equity Share fully paid up of Rs. 10/- each for the financial year ended March 31, 2024, subject to the approval of the Shareholders at the AGM.

management_commitments.claim: The company proposed the re-appointment of Devashish Mehta as Managing Director for a five-year term starting in July 2026.
management_commitments.quote: re-appointment of Mr. Devashish Mehta (DIN: 07175812) as Managing Director of the Company, who is not debarred from holding the office of Director pursuant to any SEBI order or any other such statutory authority, for a period of 5 (five) years commencing from 19th July, 2026 till 18th July, 2031

management_commitments.claim: The company proposed the re-appointment of Tavinder Singh as Whole Time Director for a one-year term starting in October 2025.
management_commitments.quote: re-appointment of Mr. Tavinder Singh (DIN: 01175243), as Whole Time Director of the Company for a further term of one year commencing from 29th October, 2025, upon expiry of his current term on 28th October, 2025

management_commitments.claim: The final dividend for the financial year 2024-25 will be paid on or before September 28, 2025.
management_commitments.quote: the payment of Final Dividend on Equity Shares, upon declaration by the Shareholders at the AGM, will be made on or before 28th September, 2025

management_commitments.claim: The company appointed M/s DR Associates as Secretarial Auditors for a five-year period starting April 2025.
management_commitments.quote: appointment of M/s DR Associates, Company Secretaries (FRN: P2007DE003300) as Secretarial Auditors of the Company for a period of 5 consecutive years, from April 1, 2025 to March 31, 2030

management_commitments.claim: The company stated it will continue to take appropriate measures to deal with changing market scenarios.
management_commitments.quote: The Company will continue to take appropriate measures to deal with the changing Market scenario.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
